The Learning Experience out today on Tici Taci and my book has gone to print at Stanford University Press

Cite as: Martin Paul Eve, "The Learning Experience out today on Tici Taci and my book has gone to print at Stanford University Press", eve.gd: Martin Paul Eve, April 26, 2019, https://doi.org/10.59348/f52m7-9xv73.

I have a music release/EP out on Tici Taci records today, called The Learning Experience.

Available for purchase at:

  • Juno Download
  • Beatport
  • Traxsource
  • Amazon

What the critics/DJs are sayin’:

  • "This has track of the year all over if for me."
  • "One of my faves from the year so far."
  • "This is a terrific release. Remixes are stellar (naturally) and will go down a storm. But for me the standout is Martin’s original of Ratholin’. Very, very funky and the vocal works a treat."
  • "This is super sick, will definitely play in sets, super strong release all around!"
  • "You know what? Think this is one of the best Tici Taci releases so far"

I also have other exciting news! Close Reading with Computers has now gone to print at Stanford University Press ahead of its release in June. Hurrah!

Martin Paul Eve
